title: v5.3.7 — Profile Overhaul & Leaderboard Realism
message: Profile popup completely filled out — stat cards are bigger with larger numbers, plus 4 new cards: Daily Streak, Lifetime XP, Bank Tier, and Combo Best. Quick access buttons for Customize, Friends, and Account added below stats. Leaderboard bot scores dramatically lowered to realistic ranges (top ~500 instead of 50,000). Each bot now has a unique random avatar. Bot names look like real player usernames.
